positions.title: Software Developer (Android)
positions.description:
Native Android development and consulting for a variety of clients
● NBA for Android
Lead Developer on team of 6-10 for major rewrite of national sports league application for Android, Amazon Fire and Android TV devices.
Features include heavy video and audio streaming, in-app purchasing, Chromecast support, live scores and stats.
● Cru MPDX
Lead developer for team of 1-3 developers to architect, design and build a mobile customer relationship management application from the ground up for a non-profit organization.  Features include offline support, local encryption, fingerprint support and data synchronization with remote database.

positions.title: Software Developer II
positions.description:
Software Developer on Store Device Platforms team
- Develop and maintain Java applications, web services, batch processes and scripts on top of Tomcat Grid infrastructure to support retail business solutions
- Native Android and mobile web development utilizing backbone.js framework and Apache Cordova to support FIRST Phone devices in store
- Perform phone screens and in person interviews, travel to college campuses and organize information sessions for internship recruitment

- Native Android and HTML5/CSS/JS mobile development
- PhoneGap plugin development
